surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during ALD involve the alternating pulsing of H2O/HfCl4 and H2O/TMA precursors. The HfCl4 precursor reacts with surface hydroxyl groups to form Hf-O-Hf species, while the TMA precursor reacts with surface hydroxyl groups to form Al-O-Hf species. The water pulse regenerates surface hydroxyl groups, completing the ALD cycle.
evidence: The text states: 'The latter was grown by using an equal number of pulses of H2O/HfCl4 and H2O/TMA...precursors in each deposition cycle for HfO2 and Al2O3, respectively.'
